title: ReAct Pattern
content: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with actions: Think, Act via tools, Observe results, then iterate until the task is done. Ground answers in tool evidence.

title: Agent Formula
content: Agent = LLM + context + tools. LLM is the policy, context is the observation space, tools are the action space.

title: Yishu Product
content: 奕枢 (Yishu) is the only user-visible identity. Voice and spatial presence are primary. Context is evidence with source, time, confidence, and expiry. Pi is execution harness; product owns identity and task truth.
